target_name: Capital and labor commitment breadth against the funding gap
rationale: This is a mechanical co-ranking of two already-tested parents (capacity-growth and hiring, both against the identical winsorized capex−oancf conditioner) whose results were nearly the same, so it is closer to averaging two known signals than to new economic content, and the emp-conditioned intersection will further thin already-low coverage.

target_name: Capacity growth with funding gap and inventory glut
rationale: Although it reuses the exact template of the archive's flow-plus-stock merge, the second conditioner (five-year own-history inventory/sales position) is an economically distinct demand-absorption dimension rather than another funding measure, and the diagnosis that the glut leg supplies cross-sectional slope while the gap leg supplies alpha is a legitimate, testable motivation.

target_name: Inventory investment against the funding gap
rationale: Pairing scaled inventory investment with the funding-gap conditioner is untested in this archive and cleanly answers whether the fragility mechanism is general to resource commitments or specific to long-lived capital, with the caveat that the carrier alone is close to the published inventory-growth/accrual anomaly so the interaction must beat that baseline to be interesting.

target_name: Capacity growth with a shrinking equity cushion
rationale: The leverage-channel test is a genuinely different route to the fragility mechanism and denser than the cash-flow version, but DELTA(ceq/at) falls mechanically whenever assets grow, so the conditioner is partly a restatement of asset growth and the result risks being a repackaging of the asset-growth/net-debt-issuance anomalies rather than evidence on funding fragility.

target_name: Capacity growth against a persistent funding gap
rationale: Replacing the one-year funding gap with its three-year moving average is a single-parameter smoothing of the generation-1 leader — the archive already brackets it with the one-year magnitude and the five-year deficit count — so the expected incremental information is small and the proposal is closer to a cosmetic variant than to a substantively different construct.

target_name: Total asset growth against the funding gap
rationale: This is effectively the generation-0 "Externally financed asset growth" signal with the binary funding indicator softened to a z-score, and it doubles as a rediscovery of the well-published asset-growth and net-external-financing anomalies, so its value is limited to benchmarking rather than new signal discovery.
